features.description: Synthetic feature standing in for the dogfood plan's implementation surface. Marked passes:true so the gate sees a 'shipped' plan; the F2 pipeline does not consume features.json beyond hashing it for the override input-bound contract.
steps: Author objective_contract.json with 3 user_journeys + 5 required_evidence matchers.
Populate post_impl/<source>/<journey>/<filename> with 4 captured artifacts (1 matcher intentionally unmatched, 1 journey intentionally orphan).
Run F001 + F002 (offline) + F003 close path; capture decisions in disposition.md.
features.acceptance: F001 surfaces ≥1 missing_evidence finding (matcher 'crash-NoneObserved') AND ≥1 journey_gap finding (journey 'error_recovery'). F002 produces the offline envelope. F003 close blocks then honors a recorded override.
